snippet.title: Harry Potter Actors Reveal Most Emotional Scenes To Film
snippet.description:
Throughout filming the epic Harry Potter franchise, a huge range of emotions was experienced and plenty of tears were shed. One scene Dan Radcliffe filmed was actually so hard to watch and listen to, that other cast members started crying - that’s powerful stuff! For one scene, Emma Watson went a bit too far with her acting chops and wept through an upsetting scene. The director actually had to pull her back and make sure the actress was alright after such an intense and moving performance. 
Saying goodbye is always hard - but it’s a particular kind of tricky when an actor is leaving a role they grew up with practically their whole lives. Wrapping certain scenes made for several emotional farewells. The final scene Rupert Grint and Emma Watson filmed together left both actors completely soaked and full of overwhelming feelings - a solid combo of the intense scene itself and knowing they were one step closer to saying goodbye to their characters forever - but luckily - it wasn’t the last time! The 20th-anniversary reunion special brought about a mix of feelings and memories from all the performers who got the chance to walk the halls of Hogwarts once again Reflecting back on such a special time and of course, the performers they’ve lost over the years, made for a complete tear-fest. Tissues were required. When Helena Bonham Carter met her end as Bellatrix Lestrange, she also happened to wrap up her time on set - so a double ending of course made for quite an overwhelming day.
No matter the day or the circumstance, these emotional moments were always met with support and care from the HP fam.
